text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh!! A magnificent run as always,
Air Groove--!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Maaarvelouuus!!
So, so, so very maaarvelouuus!!!
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (So far away—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(My seniors... the cheers from the stands...
Everything... feels so far away...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...I never intended to take it lightly.
And yet... I can't believe the gap is this vast—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, what an incredible race this year too!
Air Groove and Marvelous Sunday especially!
Their drive was on a whole other level!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober tried her hardest too, but...
when lined up against the Senior class, she still seems to be just a step short.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family really was on another level
back in McQueen's era!
Like Palmer's unbelievable breakaway win at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober...
The next day—a rainy day.

I was working in the trainer's office,
but I couldn't concentrate, making little progress...
choice_data_list: (Dober... I wonder if she was okay.)

text_block_list.text: In the end, Mejiro Dober seemed utterly exhausted after the Arima Kinen, so I could barely talk to her and simply walked her back to the dorms.

She seemed completely dejected,
so I wanted to take the time to talk it out with her, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Good work.
I knew you'd be working right after yesterday.
choice_data_list: Dober...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, is it okay if I watch TV here?
choice_data_list: Wait, TV?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Bright told me about it—
there's an Umamusume racing program starting soon
that'll be looking back on this year's Classic class."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they're covering yesterday's Arima Kinen, too...
So, I thought I'd check it out for a bit.
choice_data_list: I see...!
I see...!

text_block_list.text:
Seeing this as a good opportunity, I feel a slight sense of relief.
After all, Mejiro Dober ran admirably through the Classic tier.

The show will surely give it major coverage.
That might lift her spirits, even if just a little!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ready?
...Alright, I'll put it on now.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, during this year's Oaks,
I found myself seeing Mejiro Ramonu
in the way Dober ran.”

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Enchanting Blue-Bay'! She was magnificent~
I really still can't forget her even now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"When talking about the Arima Kinen and the Mejiro family, it has to be back-to-back Grand Prix winner Mejiro Palmer!
Her massive runaway breakaway truly gave us all something to dream about."
choice_data_list: (This is—)

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text: "Looking at Mejiro Bright's Triple Crown record, it really brings Mejiro Ryan to mind. She's truly an Umamusume you can't help but root for..."

text_block_list.name: Commentator C
text_block_list.text:
"Right, right! When you think of the Mejiro family,
it has to be the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
Mejiro McQueen was simply magnificent, wasn't she?!"
...On the TV, a program titled 'Glory of the Mejiro Family' continues to broadcast footage tracing the hoofprints of the Mejiro predecessors.
Even after that, the commentators continued to chatter on about past Mejiro glories, and similar comments lined the social media feed at the bottom of the screen...
And just like that, the program came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, does this mean—
choice_data_list: What is this...?!
What is this...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...Trainer...
Before I knew it, a voice squeezed its way past my trembling lips of its own accord.

The ones who fought through the Classic year brilliantly
were Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright.
And yet—

No one talks about them as the main characters.
It's as if they're just side dishes.
choice_data_list: Why did it have to come to this—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...Just come on.
choice_data_list: Still!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine!
To be honest... I kind of knew it myself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Running the Arima yesterday... I felt it firsthand.
The harshness of the Senior class, and my own shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I just looked up innocently at Ramonu-san, Ryan, and the others...
without realizing how high above me they truly were...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Things were fine as long as I was just looking up to them.
Ryan and the others' brilliance was just so dazzling and proud—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I used to think that all I had to do was follow
straight behind their hoofprints and keep walking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, chasing after it in earnest made me realize.
The path marked by so many proud hoofprints wasn't smooth at all—it was steep and treacherous—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Even so, the closer I get trying to reach the brilliance of those ahead of me, the more I get swallowed up in the shadows...!!"
choice_data_list: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ……It's so far away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We were supposed to define an era together...
We promised to bring 'new glory to Mejiro,' Bright and I... so why...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To think reaching that light would be so far away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To think that I'm still this weak—
choice_data_list: Still, you fought valiantly and kept trying!
But you kept on taking on the challenge so admirably!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh—

As she suddenly looked up,
I met her gaze head-on.
choice_data_list: I've been watching over you like this all along.
I've been watching over you like this all along.

text_block_list.text:
I'll say it as many times as needed.
Mejiro Dober fought through the Classic Year magnificently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest.
I haven't stopped trembling yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Even knowing what this trembling is,
it's still scary... But even so—"

Trembling, nearly breaking,
yet still rising up, continuing to challenge.

No one knows better than myself
just how brilliant the path of that challenge truly was.

To say that this... that these past two years
weren't a journey leading to glory—
choice_data_list: I won't let anyone else say it—not even you!
I won't let anyone else say it—not even you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trai, ner...
I'll say it again and again, as many times as it takes.
choice_data_list: Mejiro Dober is a strong Uma Musume.
Mejiro Dober is a strong Uma Musume, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ............ ...It hurts, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm... so frustrated, Trainer...!!
Ugh... Waaaahhh...!!

Much like the rain soaking the turf outside,
heavy tears streamed down Mejiro Dober's cheeks.

Though intending to wipe away the other's tears,
before long, her own cheeks were wet as well—
and through their tears, the two vowed to make their comeback together.
And before long, the rain stopped—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
We haven't talked about our next goal yet, have we?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... want to aim for the Osaka Hai.
choice_data_list: The Spring Senior Triple Crown route...!

text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the Tenno Sho (Spring), the Takarazuka Kinen—
That is the royal road where only the strongest Senior-class contenders gather.
choice_data_list: Still... that's all the more reason to go, isn't it?
Still... that's all the more reason to go, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Because I want to keep trying.
I don't want to throw away the promise I made with Bright just yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because I... because we are
going to become "Mejiro's new glory"!

The next goal is the Osaka Hai.
Amidst Hanshin's fluttering cherry blossoms, Mejiro Dober
signals the dawn of her comeback!
